newsitem.title: FINLAND: Ericsson says biggest in digital handsets.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says biggest in digital handsets.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications giant Ericsson CEO Lars Ramqvist said on Thursday Ericsson was the world's biggest supplier of digital mobile phones.

Ericsson's Finnish rival Nokia three weeks ago said it was the world leader in digital handsets, but Ramqvist told a news conference here that Ericsson was "as big as any other" with "25 percent or so" of the market.
"We are the biggest in digital mobile phones," he added.
Ramqvist said Ericsson's GF 788 handset model -- one of the smallest phones on the market -- was winning it market share even in Finland, Nokia's home market.
"We are taking a lot of market share with this little one here," Ramqvist said.
Ramqvist also said Ericsson was the world leader in telecommunications equipment -- excluding cables and wire phones -- and that it aimed to remain number one.
He said "nearly 40 percent of all mobile subscribers are using Ericsson's systems" and that Ericsson was active in 130 countries.
"This is not easily copied by any other company, to build in 130 countries your own organisations," he said.
